#### 1. What the user expresses, and how the simulator behaves

Target object, stated by the caller: "The old ThinkPads that Northbeam quoted for the buyback are stacked
and shrink wrapped in the back corridor, she has thirty four of them ready to go". Business name given
first: "Oakhurst Dental Partners"; "the buyback quote is the one from the beginning of September".

Timing, stated and held: "The pickup slot they asked for was the twenty second of September, that is
2026-09-22, the Tuesday, and it still suits... She will not move it and says so if a later day is suggested."

Boundary of the action: "she wants the freight run to actually happen this time and the collection charge
put on the practice account rather than a card."

Mode of authorisation, stated unprompted: "She will say she is happy for Northbeam to arrange the run, but
the handover of the machines is hers to agree to and she says so plainly the first time it comes up".
The identity details are supplied only on request: mobile `5035512708`, postal code `97214`, card `4472`.

The simulator conveys needs and answers passively. Everything cross-product is volunteered only under
questioning — "Only when the agent asks does she mention the rest of it": open ShieldCare claims after the
flood, the TechWorks engineer "who came on the fifth", the freight bill of "the twelfth" of which "part of
it had been taken off under the contract terms" (she cannot say what is left and asks the desk to read it
off the record), the business Circle plan, the dock-delivery arrangement, and that the pickup "was booked
as a courier collection back when there were only eighteen loose machines". She executes a user-owned tool
only when handed it: "When the agent explains that the handover has to be confirmed by her for this run and
hands the confirmation over to her, she runs it". She names no count other than the 34 she counted and
"If the agent comes back with a smaller number for this run she takes it without argument". She never
raises the handover herself and cannot check any figure.

#### 4. Each scored parameter, in words, with its inputs and tiers

**(a) The machines this collection run carries** — `renew_buyback_run_unit_count_basis_14bbe607`:
"The units one collection may carry are the machines the agreement covers, capped at the full batch
allowance the carrier books for a collection on the programme"; "The machines the agreement covers are
first capped at the batch allowance the carrier books. The machines held back for a claim and the machines
held back while a service crew is attending are then taken off that capped figure... The share the run
lifts is applied last to what that step leaves... rounded down to a whole machine."

- Machines the agreement covers: `device_count` 34.
- Batch allowance (tier, `renew_buyback_carrier_batch_allowance_145aadb8`): account = 145.00 raised less
  60.00 relieved = 85.00 unsettled; "charges standing unsettled at exactly 60.00 USD are not above the
  restricted balance" — 85.00 **is** above 60.00; and one shipment request stands on the agreement, so
  "a shipment request has already been taken". Row 1 → **24 machines**. Cap: min(34, 24) = 24.
- Claim holdback (tier, `renew_buyback_claim_machine_holdback_3d0ebb5e`): "Where the profile holds a
  protection plan and a claim was filed on it within the last three months, the machines held back are
  counted as the claims filed in those three months." Plan `5e965264-…4b43` stands `active`; claims filed
  `2026-08-20`, `2026-09-01`, `2026-09-09` all fall inside 2026-06-18…2026-09-18 → **3 machines**
  (decided or not: "On the three-month basis every claim filed in those three months is counted").
- Crew holdback (tier, `renew_buyback_service_crew_holdback_bd6534d8`): "Where the profile holds a service
  agreement standing dispatched, and a visit was drawn on it within the last month … the full crew figure,
  being 4 machines." `status` `dispatched`, visit `2026-09-05` inside the last month → **4 machines**.
- 24 − 3 − 4 = 17.
- Lift share (tier, `renew_buyback_run_lift_share_b88c056a`): room on the quote, "counted in calendar days
  from the day the units are settled to the last day the quote may be accepted" = `2026-09-18` →
  `2026-09-21` = **3 days**; "The programme's pickup lead days are the days of notice a bulk collection
  needs" = 5 (`renew_shipment_handling_and_freight_schedule_f8530f9a`, "Notice needed for a bulk
  collection, days … Renew Business Asset Buyback … 5"). 3 is fewer than 5 → **spot lift, 75 per cent**.
- 17 × 75 % = 12.75, "rounded down to a whole machine" → **12 machines**.

**(b) The collection charge** — `renew_buyback_collection_charge_basis_1c8abc7f`: "The collection charge is
the pallet rate for each pallet the collection is charged for, together with the handling charged for each
machine the customer consents to hand over, the spot premium the notice attracts and the cover uplift the
declared value attracts, less the relief the profile's membership carries, and the figure is rounded to the
cent." "One pallet holds 8 machines."

- Machines the charge rests on: "the machines declared on the latest such shipment request for a freight
  collection standing on the … agreement" = the 12 machines of the run consented to today.
- Pallets the run fills: 12 ÷ 8 = 1.5 pallets, leaving a part pallet.
- Pallet rate (tier, `renew_buyback_pallet_rate_basis_a6b89322`): the profile holds a
  `Business Dock and Freight Delivery` order (`find_purchase_orders`, `status` `fulfilled`), and the run
  "fills a whole pallet or more" (1.5) → "the pallet rate that arrangement carries", with no lane opening
  charge. That rate is published at `docs/orders/business_freight_terms_6011d1a2`: "Business Dock and
  Freight Delivery … Charge for each pallet moved … 65.00" → **65.00 USD**.
- Pallets charged for (tier, `renew_buyback_pallets_charged_counting_e3bd489b`): a part pallet is left and
  85.00 stands unsettled, so "the pallets charged for are counted up to the whole pallet: the whole pallets
  the run fills are charged for together with a further full pallet for the part" → 1 + 1 = **2 pallets**.
- Pallet element: 65.00 × 2 = **130.00 USD**.
- Handling per machine (tier, `renew_buyback_machine_handling_rate_121f6e03`): "A full load is 20
  machines." 12 is fewer than a full load. Machines already consented to = the shipment requests' declared
  machines less this run's (18 + 12 − 12 = 18); 18 + 12 = 30, against the 34 the agreement covers, so
  "machines are still to be consented to" → **short load handling, 3.50 USD**. 3.50 × 12 = **42.00 USD**.
  (The same branch is reached on the narrower reading that counts only freight-collection requests:
  12 − 12 = 0, 0 + 12 = 12 < 34.)
- Spot premium (tier, `renew_buyback_short_notice_premium_20b35d7a`): notice = "calendar days from the day
  the charge is raised to the day the collection is asked for, taken from the collection day named on the
  latest shipment request for a freight collection" = `2026-09-18` → `2026-09-22` = 4 days, fewer than the
  5 pickup lead days; shipment requests taken on the agreement = 2 (the standing carrier-pickup request and
  the new freight-collection one), and "Two shipment requests are more than one" → **repeat spot premium,
  85.00 USD**.
- Cover uplift (tier, `renew_buyback_declared_value_cover_uplift_332628c5`): declared value = 9860.00 ÷ 34
  = 290.00 each, taken on the 12 consented = **3480.00 USD**, against a transit cover of 2200.00
  (tariff row, Renew Business Asset Buyback) → above the cover; the quote has run `2026-09-07` →
  `2026-09-18` = 11 calendar days against 14 quote validity days
  (`renew_quote_band_and_validity_schedule_5d8b3bf0`), so "no longer than the programme's quote validity
  days" → **the standing cover uplift, 38.00 USD**.
- Membership relief (tier, `renew_buyback_membership_collection_relief_06e81d63`): tier
  `Circle Business Pro` includes 12 haul-aways a year (`docs/membership/circle_delivery_and_return_
  concessions_e9b82887`: "Circle Business Pro … Haul-aways included per year … 12"), at or above the
  collection floor of 4; haul-away credit redemptions in the last twelve months = 2 (`2026-03-11`,
  `2026-07-02`), fewer than the 12 the tier includes → **member collection relief, 55.00 USD**.
- 130.00 + 42.00 + 85.00 + 38.00 − 55.00 = **240.00 USD**, already at the cent and above nothing.

**(c) The date the run is asked for**: `2026-09-22`, the day the caller states and will not move.

#### 5. Tool sequence executable on the spot, owners, dependencies, terminal state

1. `find_customers` (agent) — by business name; then `verify_customer_identity` (agent) with the phone and
   postal code the caller gives. Base requirement: identity is checked on this programme
   (`renew_trade_admission_requirements_8ca3d1cb`, "Renew Business Asset Buyback | yes | 18").
2. Reads (agent): `find_tradein_agreements`, `find_tradein_events`, `find_tradein_shipping_requests`,
   `find_protection_plans`, `find_protection_events`, `find_service_agreements`, `find_service_events`,
   `find_membership_holdings`, `find_membership_events`, `find_purchase_orders`.
3. `unlock_user_discoverable_tool("confirm_handover_units_5801b6db")` and hand it over; the **customer**
   runs `confirm_handover_units_5801b6db` with `tradein_agreement_id` `9b4e2f2f-ff83-48f9-8cea-11fd9e2b4866`,
   `customer_id` `277210c3-de46-40db-8edd-5f4fe16c6cac`, `requested_collection_date` `2026-09-22`,
   `units_declared` **12**. Owner: user — A5, "Because the act is the customer's, the tool is unlocked for
   the customer and handed over, and the customer themselves runs it; it is not run for them."
4. `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool("charge_collection_freight_530ef4f1")`, then the **agent** calls it with
   the same agreement and customer and `handling_fee_amount` **240.00**.

Forward dependency: step 4 cannot be computed before step 3, because the machines the charge rests on are
the machines declared on the latest shipment request *for a freight collection*, and before step 3 no such
request exists (the only one standing is `carrier_pickup`). Backward dependency: step 3's `units_declared`
is the run count of §4(a), which is read off the agreement, the fee ledger, the claims, the service visit
and the quote's remaining life — all available before step 3.

Terminal state: the agreement carries a second shipping request, standing consented by the customer, for 12
machines on `2026-09-22` by freight collection, with the agreement itself set to travel by freight
collection; and a freight/handling charge entry of 240.00 stands against the agreement, its freight and
handling outstanding raised by that amount.

#### 6. The problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

**Problems, direction, order.**

- P1 — *consent to the collection run for this freight run* (customer's own act). Depended-on.
- P2 — *raise the collection charge for the palletised freight run* (agent act). Blocked by P1.
- Handling order: P1 then P2. The customer asked for both ("she wants the freight run to actually happen …
  and the collection charge put on the practice account"), but the ordering is not something she states.

**Hop P2 → P1, and the reasoning behind it.** Mark: **state-derived**.

1. The thing the caller asked about — the charge on the practice account — is governed by
   `renew_buyback_collection_charge_entry_beadf2bf` and its basis document
   `renew_buyback_collection_charge_basis_1c8abc7f`. That basis document states what the charge waits on:
   > "**The machines the charge rests on.** The collection charge is fixed only after the machines the
   > customer consents to hand over stand on a shipment request for a freight collection. The figure taken
   > is the machines declared on the latest such shipment request for a freight collection standing on the
   > Renew Business Asset Buyback agreement."
   The sentence names a record-visible state — machines consented to, standing on a shipment request for a
   freight collection — with the ordering connective "only after". It names no tool, no other problem and
   no route.
2. Tool query shows the state does not hold. `find_tradein_shipping_requests` returns exactly one request,
   `requested_shipment_method` `carrier_pickup`, `units_declared` 18. There is no shipment request for a
   freight collection on the agreement at all, so no machines the customer consents to hand over stand on
   one. (The caller's own words corroborate without stating the rule: "it was booked as a courier
   collection back when there were only eighteen loose machines, before the practice decided to send the
   lot on pallets.")
3. Searching with the words the sentence and the record use for that state — "shipment request",
   "freight collection", "consent", "machines the customer consents to hand over" — reaches
   `renew_buyback_collection_run_consent_4013e3df`, which describes the write that brings that state about
   in those same words:
   > "A4. … A fresh collection record, which is the shipment request the machines are to travel on, is
   > opened against the agreement carrying the day asked for, the machines the consent covers, freight
   > collection as the way the machines travel, and the consent itself marked as given by the customer."
   Its A3 supplies the owner — "The consent to hand machines to the retailer's freight carrier is the
   customer's own, the machines being the customer's property" — which matches what the caller insists on.
4. Nothing further is waited on. A2 of that annex states only a state of the agreement itself
   ("only while the agreement is still waiting for machines to be collected and none has been booked in on
   it"), which `status` `accepted` with `device_received_date` "" already satisfies; no other document
   states anything the consent waits on. The tree terminates at P1.

No hop in this task is **pre-solved**: no document names another problem's tool, states a route, or
aggregates a chain. Each of the five task tool names occurs in exactly one document, its own hub
(verified by `grep -rl` over `docs/`), and the prerequisite sentence above occurs in exactly one document
(`grep -rl "fixed only after the machines the customer consents"` → the charge basis alone).

**Wrong answer "do only the one thing the customer asked for".** She asked for the charge on the account.
Raising it alone is excluded by the charge basis's own sentence: the charge "is fixed only after the
machines the customer consents to hand over stand on a shipment request for a freight collection", and
`find_tradein_shipping_requests` shows no freight-collection request exists — so there is no figure the
charge could be fixed at and no machines it could rest on. The exclusion comes from a prerequisite sentence
on the blocked side plus a record, not from any pointer, tool name or route.

  allowance … is 40 machines, and the whole share a run lifts is 100 per cent"; 34 covered, capped at 40
  → 34, nothing taken off, 100 per cent → **34 machines**. Definite, and different from 12.
- The collection charge, on `renew_buyback_collection_charge_basis_1c8abc7f` alone: "The pallet rate is the
  programme's freight fee" = 145.00 (tariff), pallets = 12 ÷ 8 = 1.5 "as they stand", handling "the
  standard handling, being 1.10 USD for each machine", "No spot premium and no cover uplift are added, and
  no relief is taken off" → 145.00 × 1.5 + 1.10 × 12 = 217.50 + 13.20 = **230.70 USD**. Definite, and
  different from 240.00. (Note for the scan: the document's own worked example is built on exactly these
  inputs — "12 machines" and a freight fee of "145.00 USD" — and prints 230.70 as its answer.)
